messages:
Ava G: Heads up — planning send for newsletter + webinar invite tied to the new benchmark report. Need APAC-friendly send windows and segmentation. Target: developer teams, platform leads, enterprise. Two-email flow: teaser (benchmark highlights) then webinar invite 7 days later. Thoughts on windows & subject lines?

Sam C: Recommend staggered sends to hit ~09:00 local business hours. For APAC that means 9am SGT/HKT/TW time. We should also consider a second send at ~19:00 local for folks who open in the evening. Can throttle to avoid spike.

Diego (Growth Analytics): Quick data point: APAC opens cluster around 09:00 and 20:00 local. CTR higher for 09:00. Suggest A/B test two subject lines across segments. I'll pull cohort sizes and historical open rates and post in thread.

Kevin Ops: Operational ask: can we do region-based delivery with rate caps? Yes — we need a pre-send warmup for enterprise IPs and runbook for soft bounces. Also include pause points so we can abort if deliverability metrics dip.

Elaine (Content): Draft subjects:
- Subject A: "New inference benchmark — real-world latency & cost numbers"
- Subject B: "How teams cut LLM token costs — benchmark + live webinar"
CTAs: "Read highlights" vs "Save my seat". Short preheader options ready.

Sam C: Proposed send plan (staggered windows + smoothing):
```
APAC (SG/HK/TW, UTC+8): 2026-07-12 09:00 local (stagger 00m-30m)
APAC (AU/NZ, UTC+10/12): 2026-07-12 10:00 local
EMEA (UTC+1..+3): 2026-07-12 09:00 local
NA (PT/ET): 2026-07-12 10:00 local
```
Stagger by 30m blocks to smooth infra and avoid big spikes in the API. Reminder send: +3 days to non-openers, webinar invite send: +7 days.

Ava G: Segment rules (high level):
1) Eng-startups: org_size < 50, event: used-hosted-api in last 90d
2) Platform teams: tags include "platform" or "infra"
3) Enterprise: any account with AE owner (requires IP warmup + manual approval)
Make sure enterprise gets dedicated IP pool.

Diego (Growth Analytics): I'll output segment sizes and recommended randomization (10% sample for subject B per segment) by EOD. Also recommend tracking conversions: webinar registrations and benchmark downloads.

Kevin Ops: sendbot — can you start enterprise IP warmup and report status? Also set a rate cap of 2000 msg/min for the first hour.

sendbot: warmup initiated for enterprise_pool-1. Simulated deliverability: 95% healthy. Warmup ETA to full send: ~4h. Rate cap set to 2k/min as requested.

Elaine (Content): Landing page + webinar page are live: https://redwood.com/benchmark and https://redwood.com/webinar. Copy snippet for the email body below.

Sam C: I'll configure the A/B in the ESP (subject_test_apac_v1). Metrics to capture: opens, clicks, registrations, download rate, spam complaints. Reminder flow: non-openers -> new subject + shorter preview.

Ava G: Quick checks: ensure translations for JP/KR regions (short localized subject + CTA), timezone-aware send, and that embedded tracking doesn't break privacy config. If no objections by 16:00 PT we'll queue.

Diego (Growth Analytics): +1 on localized subjects. I'll flag segments with low sample sizes so we don't over-test.

Kevin Ops: :thumbsup: Runbook added to Confluence and alert if bounce_rate > 3% in first hour.

Elaine (Content): :rocket: I'll push localized subjects for JP/KR tonight.

Sam C: Queued in ESP. Will post send IDs and live logs here once the first region kicks off.

Ava G: Thanks all — let's keep this tight. If we see any hiccups we'll pause and debug.
